description: Expert-consensus SEMU thresholds: per-subtype MEDIAN over the five inspection engineers of the perceptual study (supplementary Sec. S3, Part B; survey granularity 0.5 SEMU) for the perception (engineer_visible) and reject (reject_visible) thresholds. They are applied to the panel-level instance visibility `panel_instance_semu` (95th percentile of local visibility over the instance's visible pixels) and define the second label set is_visible_expert / is_reject_expert. Under them the number of unique reject instances rises from 1,715 (author thresholds, instance_is_reject) to 2,188 (+28%), concentrated in region (puddle_blob 2.0 -> 1.5) and banding (2.0 -> 1.0); gradients are tolerated more (4.0 -> 4.5). The author thresholds in muratrace_thresholds.json define the released masks and the default flags.
